project_name: OnEye — Real-Time CCTV Anomaly & Crime Detection Platform
theme: Dark Red-Black Command Center (Tactical Surveillance Ops)
emotional_archetype: The Performance Pro / Tactical Surveillance Command

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight uppercase
hierarchy.section_heading: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase text-zinc-100
hierarchy.mono_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-red-500/90 font-medium

layout.mobile: Single column vertical stack, collapsible sidebar or slide-over drawer navigation, sticky top tactical status bar with alert ticker, max image height 80vh
layout.desktop: Sidebar navigation + Top status nav + Multi-pane command grid (Live Feeds, Incident Map, Alert Queue, Analytical Widgets)

responsive.overflow_guard: Use `overflow-x-hidden w-full max-w-full` on top containers; grid and flex children use `min-w-0` to avoid viewport blowing on small screens
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px height/width for buttons, links, icon toggles, and status markers on touch viewports

layout_patterns.landing_page: High-impact storytelling hero with camera visual background + live anomaly detection demo preview + stat grid + role login CTAs + interactive mission timeline
layout_patterns.police_dashboard: Command center view with split-pane layout: Live Alert Feed with Red Pulsing overlay on left, Interactive Map & Clip Player details on right, Action Triage bar (Acknowledge/Respond/Resolve/False Positive)
layout_patterns.admin_dashboard: Global oversight grid: Live Camera Network Map + Contributor Approval Queue cards + Station Dispatch Manager + System-wide Analytics (Shadcn/Recharts) + Emergency Override
layout_patterns.contributor_dashboard: Citizen Portal: Camera Submission Form (Interactive Map Pin + RTSP/Video Upload) + Active Stream Status List + Personal Safety Score & Community Leaderboard

component_guidelines.live_feed_grid: Grid of camera cards with status badge ('LIVE' in green / 'ALERT DETECTED' in pulsing red), camera metadata overlay, bounding box HUD visualizers, click-to-expand clip modal
component_guidelines.alert_detail_modal: Embedded video clip player with frame scrubbing, AI detection tags (e.g. 'Weapon Detected - 98% confidence'), location map snippet, incident timeline, and instant dispatch action buttons
component_guidelines.tactical_cards: Dark zinc surface (#18181b) with 1px border (#27272a or red highlight), corner HUD accents, clear contrast data labels
component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Pulsing red alert banners via Sonner with emergency siren micro-animation and one-click 'View Incident' quick action

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Red-Black command center visual theme throughout all views and role dashboards.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, alert status toggles, video playback controls) includes explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='alert-ack-button').
Build clean role switching via Top Nav / Login modal allowing persistent state for Police, Admin, and Contributor users.
Provide responsive mobile layouts: on mobile, collapse sidebar into a mobile drawer, convert tables to touch-friendly card stacks, and ensure video clips fit screen dimensions with max 80vh limit.
Utilize Sonner for red-pulsing tactical alerts when new crime/anomaly incidents occur.
Ensure no text overlaps translucent backgrounds; header must use solid dark slate/zinc (#09090b with backdrop blur) with subtle red border.
